preconditions.description: The number of times the phrase p should appear as a subsequence in the string s is at least 1 and at most 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the string s is greater than 0.
The length of the string p is greater than 0.
The length of the string s is at most 200.
The length of the string p is at most 200.
The phrase p appears in the string s as a subsequence exactly n times.
